author: Galrandir
body:
• Your minecraft username: Galrandir
  • The reason you were tempbaned/banned: Tempbaned for spawn killing
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: This is my first tempban and it wasn't just me who was spawn killing. I only went into their spawn once and as soon as I realized I was spawn killing, I immediately retreated back to a kill farming position. I am honestly really sorry I was spawn killing and I promise I shall never do it again.
